spells.name: Lumos
spells.definition: Illuminates the tip of the caster's wand, producing a bright light.

spells.name: Expelliarmus
spells.definition: The Disarming Charm; forces an opponent to drop whatever they are holding.

spells.name: Avada Kedavra
spells.definition: The Killing Curse; inflicts instant, unblockable death upon the target.
